requirements: PAL A1200, 68EC020 interpreter, Alice/Lisa, 2 MiB Chip RAM, no slow/Fast RAM. One DD/HD OFS/FFS DF0 disk and/or one existing OFS/FFS/SFS/SFS2 HDF on unit 0 (explicit partitions or RDB). Native read/write and quick formatting for DOS0/DOS1, SFS0 and SFS2; DOS2-DOS5 remain read-only. No RTC, RTG or shared folders. Paired 1 MiB image: 512 KiB E00000 filesystem extension followed by the 512 KiB F80000 reset ROM with graphics.
producerSourceSnapshot: Development Full ROM pair from artifacts/full-filesystems-v2-20261105/rom-full-v5 and its frozen source/input hashes. Maintained CopperFS OFS/FFS/SFS/SFS2 formatters are source-linked; the existing SFS engines remain the pinned CopperSFS dependency. CSEE/15 supplies the shared filesystem task, SFS/SFS2 and native DOS client service. One mount state, ordinary guest Exec/device I/O and ROM-resident routine bodies. Qualification and limits: docs/COPPERSTART_FULL_FILESYSTEMS_V2_2026-11-05.md. No package/ROM publication or throughput qualification.
